_doc: The possible SYSTEM STRUCTURES. Each preset declares which boards the structure needs, which Axis apps it drives, and the app-settings 'flavor' (the keys whose values differ by structure). The interview picks ONE preset, then options (customers/wbs/routine) add boards on top. provision.py builds only the boards a structure needs (creating missing ones, mapping existing ones) and renders the app settings from the matching flavor. Tracker has two reporting modes: assignments-mode (project source = Allocations) vs tasks/portfolio-mode. Planner always writes Allocations and reads Employees + Portfolio.

portfolio_full.label: Full portfolio system — Planner + Tracker (assignments mode)
portfolio_full.summary: The דמו 8/6 shape. Planner plans allocations; Tracker reports time against those allocations. Portfolio is the project master, Allocations is the hinge, Time Logs receives reports.

tracker_only_assignments.label: Time tracking only — Tracker, assignments mode (no Planner)
tracker_only_assignments.summary: Allocations already define who may report on what (perhaps maintained manually or by another tool). Tracker reports time against them. No capacity planning UI.

tracker_only_tasks.label: Time tracking only — Tracker reports against a projects/tasks board (no assignments, no Planner)
tracker_only_tasks.summary: Everyone may report on any active project/task. Tracker reads a projects board (and optional tasks board) directly. Simplest tracking setup.

planner_only.label: Capacity planning only — Planner (no time tracking)
planner_only.summary: Plan allocations of employees to projects and see capacity/availability. No Time Logs, no Tracker, no reported-vs-planned.

customers.doc: Adds a Customers board + `client`/`customer` board_relation columns on Portfolio, Allocations, Time Logs.

projectStructure.doc: Adds a WBS template board for one flagship project, built from an Excel file, linked from Portfolio.link.

routine.doc: Adds the שוטף primary label + a `routineType` secondary status to Time Logs (Tracker nonBillableStatusColumnId). Use only when the client has ongoing non-project work.
